description: List a GitHub repository's issues from https://github.com/<owner>/<repo>/issues. state=open (default, 未关闭) | closed (已关闭) | all (全部) filters by status; sort=created (default, 按创建时间) | updated (按更新时间) | comments (按评论数) orders the list. Returns issue cards with number, title, state, author, labels, comment count, and created/updated dates. Reads the repository's issues via the page's own data source (no API quota); no login required.

parameters.name: repo
parameters.description: Repository as owner/repo (e.g. facebook/react) or its full URL https://github.com/facebook/react/issues.（仓库标识：`owner/repo` 或完整 URL，如 `facebook/react`。）

parameters.name: state
parameters.description: Issue state: open (default, 未关闭) | closed (已关闭) | all (全部). Maps to the Open/Closed tabs on the issues page.

parameters.name: sort
parameters.description: Sort order: created (default, 按创建时间) | updated (按更新时间) | comments (按评论数). Maps to the issues page sort dropdown.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Maximum issues to return (1-100, default 20).（条数上限。）
